requests.submitted_prose: In the stated tenant/trespasser setting, the Court held that the landlord retained legal or constructive possession through the tenant and could seek Section 6 recovery when that tenant was forcibly dispossessed by a third party. This resolves standing, not independently verified title or filing timeliness.

rule_scope_limits: Maintainability only. Section 6 time limit, consent, due-course-of-law and government exclusion remain; title is not adjudicated by this rule.
Maintainability through legal possession and non-fatal nonjoinder; not proof of ownership or a new general ejectment entitlement.
